summary: Solaris Energy Infrastructure, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the entry into a purchase agreement for a private placement of $1.3 billion aggregate principal amount of its 6.375% Senior Notes due 2031. The notes will be issued at par, with net proceeds of ~$1,279.3 million after discounts and expenses, expected to close May 12, 2026. Proceeds are for repaying outstanding borrowings, fees, and general corporate purposes including growth capex. The filing describes a routine debt financing, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No special-situation event is triggered; the registrant is simply raising debt capital.
